facts.fact: The appraisal document, dated 4 May 2011, treats a National ICT Policy as existing, with the project coordination unit to monitor its implementation and the steering committee to check project activities against it; the document does not describe the policy's scope.

The project coordination unit, anchored in the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications in charge of ICT (MPTNTC), is to monitor implementation of the National ICT Policy and the government's ICT strategy, per the 2011 appraisal document.
